description: Your cash, gold and diamonds always show the maximum. You never run short of money.
name: Unlimited currency

description: Loads the unlimited money save into the game the first time you open it.
name: Unlimited money (restore save)

description: Packs the special save file (unlimited coins & gems, everything unlocked) inside the app.
name: Unlimited money (save bundle)

description: Free coins forever. Your point balance always reads as the maximum, so you can afford anything in the shop. You can still spend and save normally.
name: Unlimited Points

description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.
name: Copy direct link

description: Stops the AppLovin MAX mediation stack — and with it Pangle, Amazon APS, Chartboost, InMobi, Mintegral, Fyber, Bigo and the rest — from ever initialising. The game starts faster and makes no ad-network requests at all. Requires "Remove ads": on its own it would only make the app fail to find ads, not stop asking for them.
name: Disable ad SDK

description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, both switchable from the Morphe settings screen.
name: Disable ads

description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.
name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking

description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.
name: Disable email confirmation dialog

description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).
name: Disable Google Engage

description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.
name: Disable Google Engage worker

description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. Push notifications keep working.
name: Disable third-party trackers

description: Hands out an empty Google Advertising ID with "limit ad tracking" turned on, and stops AppsFlyer from sending install attribution and events. The game keeps working normally: nothing in it waits for attribution data.
name: Disable tracking

description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.
name: Download board

description: Checks for an original image before downloading, with automatic fallback to the largest available app variant.
name: Download images in highest available quality

description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.
name: Download pin from long press

description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.
name: Download video

description: Hides selected native pin menu actions by their localized labels, one per line.
name: Filter pin menu actions

description: Collapses Pinterest's ad-only views, so no ad chrome is drawn even if the app builds one. Follows the "Disable ads" switch.
name: Hide ad views

description: Hides the pin comments section, the comment preview and the comments button, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.
name: Hide comments

description: Hides the "+" (create Pin) navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.
name: Hide Create nav button

description: Hides the create and inbox buttons in the home feed header, when the matching Morphe settings are enabled.
name: Hide greeting header buttons

description: Hides the notifications navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.
name: Hide Notifications nav button

description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after a screenshot, and stops it watching for screenshots where possible.
name: Hide screenshot share menu

description: Hides the "Recent searches" section on the search screen and below the search bar. Pinterest still logs searches server-side.
name: Hide search history

description: Hides the search navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.
name: Hide Search nav button

description: Grants the reward of every "watch an ad" button — hints, streak repairs, extra puzzles — immediately, without playing a video. This is what keeps those buttons working once "Remove ads" is enabled: without it the game believes no video is available and hands out nothing.
name: Instant rewards

description: Resolves the class Pinterest builds its toasts with, so Morphe's messages look like the app's own.
name: Morphe runtime names

description: Adds the "Morphe" item to the Account Settings list to open the toggle screen.
name: Morphe settings entry

description: Renames the reused string resource for the "Morphe" entry in Settings, across all languages.
name: Morphe settings screen (label)

description: Registers the Morphe settings Activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.
name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)

description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces "limit ad tracking", without crashing the app.
name: Neutralize advertising ID

description: Opens links in the phone's default browser instead of Pinterest's in-app browser, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.
name: Open links in the default browser

description: Collapses the empty strip the banner used to occupy at the bottom of the board, so the puzzle gets the space back instead of staring at a blank rectangle. Only useful together with "Remove ads".
name: Reclaim ad banner space

description: Turns off every ad Easy Sudoku shows: the home banner, the interstitials between puzzles, the app-open ad and all the background preloading. It works by telling the game its own "ads removed" purchase is already active, which also unlocks the Fun, Ice and Killer Sudoku modes that are otherwise gated behind watching ads. Keep "Instant rewards" enabled too, or the "watch an ad for a hint" buttons stop giving anything.
name: Remove ads

description: Turns the pin.it link that "Copy link" copies, whose slug identifies who shared it, into the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.
name: Sanitize copied links

description: Strips tracking parameters from the link on the Android share sheet and resolves pin.it short links to the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.
name: Sanitize shared links

description: Adds a "Set as wallpaper" option to the pin menu, which downloads the image and sets it as the device wallpaper.
name: Set pin as wallpaper

description: Shows optional image dimensions and format below the image or instead of like/comment actions.
name: Show pin image information

description: Opens the Android system share sheet instead of Pinterest's in-app share sheet, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.
name: Use the system share sheet

description: Spoofs rewarded ad callbacks to grant coins/rewards without showing ads.

description: Spending money increases your balance instead of decreasing it (native libil2cpp.so patch).

description: Kizu Twitch enhancements: third-party emotes in chat and a separate third-party emote menu, animated emote playback, live ad blocking, appearance controls, privacy controls, and patched-app compatibility.

options.description: Accepts either a full Java package name (for example, com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr) or a display suffix (for example, Galaxy XR). Suffix input appends to app name and generates a package suffix automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history and can reduce VRLink's stock four controller pose sends per display frame.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
options.title: Controller pose-send cadence

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions.
name: Device identity

options.description: Recommended uses Meta Quest Pro on exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244 (including 5001712), and Galaxy XR otherwise. Explicit profiles override that choice. Native-XR routing and verified legacy payloads are preserved.
options.title: HMD identity

description: Bypasses the two verified capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.
name: Force HMD initialization gates

description: Bypasses the verified permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.
name: Force lobby permission-state gate

description: Bypasses the three verified XR gates in builds 5001712, 5001740, and 5002244. Build 5002313 rewrote XrSceneStream::Init and is intentionally left unchanged.
name: Force stream XR gates

description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, 5002296, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322. Preserves each build's native projection layout (2 layers on 2.0.20/5001712; 3 layers on supported 2.0.22 builds) and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.
name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix

description: Selects the 16-patch Galaxy XR legacy set, including Meta Quest Pro identity, native gates, face bridge, OLED calibration, microphone, battery, Visual Delay, and XR foundation. High-resolution output is guarded to verified layouts; unavailable on 5001740, 5002172, and 5002206.
name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)

description: Applies the 16-patch Galaxy XR legacy set for exact Steam Link 2.0.20 build 5001712, including Meta Quest Pro identity, permission-free high resolution, and the Final balanced tested OLED profile.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.20/5001712)

description: Applies the existing native-Android-XR-safe Galaxy XR patch set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002318.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002318)

description: Applies the validated permission-free Galaxy XR patch set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002322, including the Final balanced tested OLED profile.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002322)

description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest. See the [GXR Face Bridge source](https://github.com/compdoge/gxr-face-bridge) and matching [Galaxy XR VRCFT module](https://github.com/compdoge/LinkFT).
name: GXR face bridge

description: Selects the Android AAudio microphone processing mode used by Steam Link. Galaxy XR testing found Voice Recognition clearer and louder than stock Voice Communication.

options.description: Voice Recognition was the clearest usable-level mode in Galaxy XR recordings. Voice Performance and Unprocessed were substantially quieter; Voice Communication sounded more processed.

description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.

description: Opens Android's per-app Battery usage page at startup so Unrestricted can be selected for XR streaming.
